intro.title: NASA's TESS Mission Finds Planetary System in New Way：句句精读
intro.description: 按原文 001-005 的顺序整理 46 个句子，包含英文原句、中文翻译、句子结构、重点词汇词组和难度标记，适合通读复盘与天文科技新闻精读。

sections.title: 001 · NASA's TESS Mission Finds Planetary System in New Way
sections.description: 介绍 TESS 首次借助时空涟漪识别系外行星，以及 Gaia23bra b 的发现背景。

items.en: For the first time, NASA's TESS (Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite) mission has identified a planet orbiting a distant star thanks to ripples in space-time.
items.zh: NASA 的 TESS（凌日系外行星巡天卫星）任务首次借助时空涟漪，发现了一颗围绕遥远恒星运行的行星。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: NASA's TESS mission has identified a planet.

analysis.label: 修饰成分
analysis.text: For the first time 作句首时间/范围状语；(Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite) 解释 TESS 全称；orbiting a distant star 是现在分词短语修饰 planet；thanks to... 说明发现得以实现的原因。

analysis.label: 语法要点
analysis.text: 现在完成时 has identified 强调首次发现的结果；thanks to 后接名词短语表示原因。

items.structure: NASA's TESS mission has identified a planet.

phrases.zh: 凌日系外行星巡天卫星
phrases.note: NASA 的系外行星探测任务，主要通过恒星亮度变化寻找行星。
指引力造成的时空变化，这里与微引力透镜现象有关。

items.en: Unlike the star-hugging transiting planets TESS regularly reveals, the newfound world is a super-Jupiter orbiting far from its host star.
items.zh: 不同于 TESS 经常发现的那些紧贴恒星运行的凌日行星，这个新发现的天体是一颗远离其主恒星运行的超级木星。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: The newfound world is a super-Jupiter.

analysis.label: 修饰成分
analysis.text: Unlike... 是句首对比状语；TESS regularly reveals 是省略关系代词的定语从句，修饰 planets；orbiting far from its host star 修饰 super-Jupiter。

analysis.label: 语法要点
analysis.text: unlike 引出对比；现在分词 orbiting 作后置定语，说明行星运行位置。

items.en: "When TESS launched, no one expected it to ever be capable of finding this kind of planet," said Diana Dragomir, a professor at the University of New Mexico in Albuquerque and co-author of a paper describing the results.

items.en: At 1.6 times Jupiter's mass and a similar orbital distance, it would be extremely unlikely to find such a planet via the primary detection method TESS was designed for.

items.en: Astronomers found the first hint of the planet, called Gaia23bra b, in 2023 using ESA's (European Space Agency) now-retired Gaia space telescope.
items.zh: 2023 年，天文学家利用 ESA（欧洲航天局）现已退役的 Gaia 太空望远镜，首次发现了这颗名为 Gaia23bra b 的行星线索。

items.en: Gaia's alert system flagged a star that brightened — something that can happen when a foreground star passes in front of a more distant one and magnifies its light through gravitational microlensing.
items.zh: Gaia 的警报系统标记了一颗变亮的恒星；当前景恒星从更遥远的恒星前方经过，并通过引力微透镜放大其光线时，就可能出现这种现象。

sections.title: 002 · NASA's TESS Mission Finds Planetary System in New Way
sections.description: 说明该行星距离、质量、轨道特征，以及 TESS 常用凌日法的适用范围。

items.en: The team's analysis, published July 1 in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, revealed that Gaia23bra b, which orbits an orange dwarf star that's about 80 percent of the Sun's mass, is nearly 40,000 light-years away from Earth, far exceeding TESS's usual search radius of about 150 light-years.
items.zh: 研究团队 7 月 1 日发表在《The Astrophysical Journal Letters》上的分析显示，Gaia23bra b 围绕一颗橙矮星运行，这颗恒星质量约为太阳的 80%；该行星距离地球近 4 万光年，远远超出 TESS 通常约 150 光年的搜索半径。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: The team's analysis revealed that Gaia23bra b is nearly 40,000 light-years away.

analysis.label: 修饰成分
analysis.text: published July 1... 是过去分词短语修饰 analysis；that 引导宾语从句；which orbits... 是非限制性定语从句；far exceeding... 是现在分词短语说明距离超出通常范围。

analysis.label: 语法要点
analysis.text: 长句主干是 analysis revealed that...；多个插入和从句补充发表信息、恒星特征和距离比较。
